// This test deletes a component before the test runs. The component
// created the schedule of its own domain by calling set_domain(). The
// schedule must remain valid in the domain graph, and the deleted
// component must no longer be a child of its parent.

#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

using namespace uvm;
using namespace sc_core;

bool failed = false;
int run_count = 0;

class leaf : public uvm_component
{
 public:
  leaf(uvm_component_name name) : uvm_component(name) {}

  void main_phase(uvm_phase& phase)
  {
    phase.raise_objection(this);
    run_count++;
    wait(10, SC_NS);
    phase.drop_objection(this);
  }
};

class test : public uvm_component
{
 public:
  leaf* tmp;
  leaf* keep;

  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(test);

  static uvm_domain& get_domain()
  {
    static uvm_domain dom("tmp_domain");
    return dom;
  }

  test(uvm_component_name name) : uvm_component(name)
  {
    // tmp creates the schedule of the domain, keep shares it
    tmp = new leaf("tmp");
    tmp->set_domain(get_domain());
    keep = new leaf("keep");
    keep->set_domain(get_domain());

    delete tmp;
    tmp = nullptr;
  }

  void connect_phase(uvm_phase& phase)
  {
    if (get_num_children() != 1 || has_child("tmp") || !has_child("keep"))
    {
      failed = true;
      UVM_ERROR("CHILDREN", "Deleted component is still a child of its parent");
    }
  }

  void report_phase(uvm_phase& phase)
  {
    if (run_count != 1)
    {
      failed = true;
      UVM_ERROR("RUN", "Expected exactly one main phase execution");
    }

    if (failed)
      std::cout << "** UVM TEST FAILED **" << std::endl;
    else
      std::cout << "** UVM TEST PASSED **" << std::endl;
  }
};

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  test t("test");
  run_test();
  return 0;
}
